channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Three US military personnel killed, five seriously wounded; US CENTCOM rejects Iran's claim of hitting USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: The US military confirmed three service members were killed in action during operations against Iran, while Tehran's Revolutionary Guard claimed a ballistic missile strike on the USS Abraham Lincoln following the reported death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei

item.title: Israel launches forceful airstrikes on Beirut's southern suburbs following Hezbollah's rocket attack
item.description: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam condemned the attacks and warned against dragging the country into conflict. The escalation reflects rising tensions in the regional war between Israel, the US, Iran, and its allies. Air raid sirens sounded in northern Israel, though no casualties were reported.

item.title: Sensex sinks over 1,000 pts on Mideast turmoil, Nifty below 24,900; all sectors in red
item.description: Indian equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty are set to open sharply lower on Monday, with Gift Nifty futures trading around 25,170 -- down roughly 210 points, or about 0.8 per cent, from its last close.

item.title: Israeli strikes hit Gandhi Hospital in Tehran, visuals show damage; US, Israel target Revolutionary Guards, other Iranian sites
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced that US forces have destroyed and sunk nine Iranian naval ships and struck key Iranian military facilities, including their Naval Headquarters, as part of Operation Epic Fury. CENTCOM confirmed that B-2 stealth bombers targeted Iran's ballistic missile facilities, and a Jamaran-class corvette was sunk in the Gulf of Oman

item.title: Iranian missile strike on Israel's Beit Shemesh kills nine people
item.description: At least nine people have died in Iran's missile strike on the Israeli town of Beit Shemesh, as Iran continued retaliatory attacks against Israel and United States military assets across several Middle Eastern countries after Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in an Israel-US strike.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu vows further strikes on Tehran; Iran's FM says 'no victory in this war'
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to intensify strikes "in the heart of Tehran" following a high-level security summit, claiming a joint effort with the United States now allows Israel to decisively strike the Iranian regime after four decades of planning

item.title: US‑Iran conflict: Oil seen rising by 8%, gold & silver rally; India's economy and stock market at risk
item.description: Escalating tensions in West Asia have driven up crude oil prices, threatening India's heavily import-reliant economy. Higher crude oil prices can raise India's import bill, widen its current account deficit, weaken the currency, raise inflation, and trigger foreign capital outflows.

item.title: Vijay Deverakonda holds Rashmika close during temple visit, treats fans to sweets; reception by invitation only
item.description: Newlywed Rashmika Mandanna met Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy to personally invite him to her wedding reception in Hyderabad on March 4. The reception for Rashmika and Vijay Deverakonda will be a strictly invitation-only event, following police recommendations.

item.title: SS Rajamouli and Mahesh Babu hail Priyanka Chopra's performance in The Bluff
item.description: SS Rajamouli and Mahesh Babu have watched Priyanka Chopra's latest release The Bluff and hailed her performance. The movie is another testament to the actress' talent.

item.title: Trump says 'there will likely be more' US deaths as Iran strikes to continue until 'all' goals achieved
item.description: US President Donald Trump has vowed to continue the "righteous mission" against Iran, warning that more American troops are likely to die.He described the war as a response to an existential threat, claiming an Iran armed with long-range missiles and nuclear weapons would endanger every American.
